name: False doctrine
about: False gospels, false prophets and false churches.

teachings.title: The bread of life is not a wafer
teachings.summary: Jesus' eating His flesh means believing on His sacrifice, so transubstantiation and real-presence sacraments are carnal misreadings like Nicodemus's.
teachings.text:
So now, again, the Jews and especially the Pharisees among them, being natural men and not understanding the spiritual things of God, fail the test of understanding that Jesus held out to them, and so He moves further from the milk of the word to the meat. For if they cannot understand the simple things and the parables and analogies, then Jesus may as well preach harder things and more difficult, dark sayings.

*Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.* They don't get it.

*I am that bread of life.* Nope. They can't understand.

*Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead. This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die. I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.*

Here Jesus gives the full Gospel, and compares it again to the manna from Heaven which fed the body, but not the soul. He explains his flesh, his actual physical body will be sacrificed on the cross, that He'll die physically to bring salvation to the world, that that is the way he is the bread of life. How spiritual bread can be His flesh.

And again, like Nicodemus, the Jews do not understand the spiritual things of God, being natural men. And instead they take it literally to mean actually eating bread that is made of his flesh. They turn what is basic salvation into cannibalism in their lack of understanding.

Many denominations today take that literal approach to what Jesus is saying, and make a sacrament of literally feeding their belly with literal bread that they claim is literally flesh. Some, like the catholics, invented a doctrine of Hocus pocus, that the priest blessing their wafers and alcohol miraculously turns it into literal flesh and literal blood that must be consumed by the body in order to be spiritually saved. That's wicked as hell.

Other denominations try to split down the middle and claim that while yes, it is symbolic, it's still "the real presence of Jesus," and necessary for salvation to consume earthly bread and earthly alcohol or juice. They may as well be crawling up inside their mother's womb to be born again, these foolish Nicodemuses.

By the way, the Bible says that wherever two or three are present in his name, the real presence of Jesus is there. Not inside a wafer or a cracker or a crouton.

teachings.title: Rome is shifting sand
teachings.summary: The Catholic church adds to God's word and changes doctrine with the times, so it is shifting sand that cannot be a foundation for faith.
teachings.text:
I know it's difficult to hear that the Catholic church is not a rock, it's not even a stone like peter, it is a shifting ever-changing, false religion that has added doctrines at the whims of what's popular, even going against earlier declarations of heresy. They add to the word of God, and because of this, you cannot base your beliefs on it the way you can biblical fundamentalism. Because they'll pull the rug right out from under you. The rushing rivers of time will move you because it is a shifting sand false religion.

Whatever good you might feel like you get out of it, you're missing out on everything God has in store for believers by clinging to these vain traditions of men.

teachings.title: Trent's anathema on faith alone
teachings.summary: The Council of Trent's curse on justification by faith alone puts the Catholic Church against the Bible, which teaches salvation by grace through faith without works.
teachings.text:
The Council of Trent, on salvation by faith alone:

CANON IX.-If any one saith, that by faith alone the impious is justified; in such wise as to mean, that nothing else is required to co-operate in order to the obtaining the grace of Justification, and that it is not in any way necessary, that he be prepared and disposed by the movement of his own will; let him be anathema

CANON XII.-If any one saith, that justifying faith is nothing else but confidence in the divine mercy which remits sins for Christ’s sake; or, that this confidence alone is that whereby we are justified; let him be anathema.

The Bible is anathema to the Catholic Church. Jesus Christ Himself, and Paul, Peter, James, all heretics and anathema to them.

**John 5:24**
*Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.*

**Romans 11:6**
*And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.*

**Romans 3:20**
*Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.*

**Ephesians 2:8**
 *For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God.*

**John 3:16**
*For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.*

teachings.title: Hell is real, and Mary had other children
teachings.summary: Jesus preached Hell often, and Matthew 13 names Jesus' brothers and sisters, refuting Mary's perpetual virginity.
teachings.text:
And when Jesus says that the tares should be burned in the fire, the wailing and gnashing of teeth, he is preaching on Hell. Those falsely claiming there is no Hell, or that Christ didn't talk about it are lying. He does frequently, yet many whose heart is by the wayside, or even the stoney ground, blindly believe the lies, having no root in the truth of the word.

As for the Mary worshipers, another L.

*Is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?* *And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?*

His half-brothers and sisters, Mary not a perpetual virgin. Sick and twisted false doctrine rebuked, amen.

teachings.title: The leaven of the Pharisees is their doctrine
teachings.summary: Jesus uses bread for the word and leaven for false doctrine, and natural men who take it literally turn it into a materialistic cannibal sacrament.
teachings.text:
Matthew 16, the chapter that contains the one half-sentence, stripped of all context and twisted into blasphemy, that Catholics use to justify the false church's existence.

It is an interesting chapter, serving as a transition for Jesus'earthly ministry from service to the masses, finding the lost sheep, to preparing for the end, the death burial and resurrection.

It begins as most of Matthew, with a short story of Pharisees and Sadducees and scribes, coming to Jesus and attempting to trap Him or trick Him with leading questions, this time again asking Jesus to perform some kind of sign, and again He rebukes them that they should see the sign of the times all around them, but perceiving not the things of God, the only sign that will be given them is the sign of Jonas, signifying His approaching fate and triumphant resurrection following 3 days and 3 nights in Hell.

And, as throughout Matthew, Jesus takes the opportunity to preach, here teaching His Apostles, saying beware the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees. The apostles, who we are told were focused on their forgetting bread for the journey, questioned if He was talking about actual bread, literal food, and their lack of it. Jesus reproaching them to focus on what He's teaching, spiritual things, and to not worry about he material. Didn't He just feed thousands, repeatedly, with physical bread? He wants them to focus on the spiritual aspect of His parable.

*How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees? Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.*

Jesus repeatedly uses bread as an allegory for the word of God, for scripture and for doctrine being taught. The daily wisdom from God's word we are to pray for. The bread from Heaven that if we should eat, never hunger again. That gives eternal life. It is spiritual, not actual wheat and water. And the leaven, which often represents sin in these parables, is the false teaching and doctrines of the Pharisees and Sadducees, which infecting the "lump," the "dough" of proper doctrine, will grow and spread, corrupting it.

Natural man misunderstanding, making Jesus' parables using bread as imagery, cannot grasp that He is speaking of spiritual things, of God and His doctrine. That man lives not by bread alone but by every word of the living God. That Jesus, like mana, is the the bread to come down from Heaven, giving eternal life to all who partake in it. That the flesh profits nothing, that this is spiritual.

And, lacking discernment, the natural man proceeds to turn what is an eloquent teaching moment preached to us by the Son of God, into a materialistic cannibal-cult ritual. That little leaven of misunderstanding infecting the whole lump with its yeast, and creating a worldly sacrament that people put their faith in rather than the word of God.

teachings.title: Get thee behind me, Satan: the first pope rebuked
teachings.summary: Peter's rebuke right after his confession shows he held no special position, and a materialistic, literal religion of relics, wine and vestments savours the things of men and is satanic.
teachings.text:
Just a few verses later, Peter, their "first pope," foolishly protests the fate Christ has revealed unto them, that Jesus should suffer and die by the Jews in Jerusalem.

Jesus rebukes him by calling him Satan, "for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men."

The juxtaposition of the two events in rapid succession, divinely inspired to show precisely that Peter was not anything special by way of position. He's just a stand-in for us as we struggle with our faith and understanding.

And once again Jesus makes a point of the difference between the spiritual things of God, which is His focus, and the things of man. Not being able to rightly divide the word of God, and applying earthly things to spiritual Doctrine, a natural man understanding, is satanic. A materialistic literal interpretation of scripture is from the devil. And you can see in the false doctrines of men and their vain traditions, all revolve around the material. The physical penance, the actual bread and wine, the graven images and statues and idolatry, the vestments and fancy architecture, offices and vestments, and accumulation of gold and silver and treasure by the church... It is all satanic because it is all material, not spiritual.

teachings.title: Faith in things unseen against material religion
teachings.summary: Faith is the evidence of things unseen, and the world's religions need idols, crackers, priesthoods and temples because they are materialistic and cannot save.
teachings.text:
This reminds me of Reinhardt study of Hebrews that's going on now on his channel, and it rem6 how in [Hebrews chapter 11](https://t.me/HouseOfWews2/5206) we see the focus of faith over literally seeing something, that Moses and the other examples accepted things on food, which is the evidence of things unseen. In their hearts they believed what God was telling them. They didn't need to see it physically in order to believe.

It's the same application, the understanding that the things Jesus is teaching us on are not things of this world. It's not an earthly kingdom, but I have a new one. It's not eternal life of our corruptible flesh by eating literally bread or his literal flesh, but the spirit that quickens from accepting the word in our hearts.

The religions of this world are materialistic and unable to bring people to salvation, eternal life, through faith in the unseen.

It's why they need to use idols and images, bowing to statues and graven things. Eating crackers and cubes of bread. Drinking alcohol and believing it's really blood.

It's why they need temples built by hand filled with treasures of the Earth. It's why they need works, good deeds and attempts to turn from sin that are visible to all. It's why they pray vain repetitions in public, using worry beads, thinking they'll be heard by much speaking as the heathen do.

It's why they need an actual priesthood, of monks in vestments and robes, silly hats identifying offices of an earthly organization.

It's all materialism and it's all prayers for the god of this world.

teachings.title: Doctrines of devils: forbidding to marry
teachings.summary: The Spirit expressly foretold departures teaching forbidding to marry and abstaining from meats, doctrines of devils later taken up by the Roman Catholic Church.
teachings.text:
Paul, expressly speaking in the Spirit, warns that in the latter times, the period post-ascension and before the day of the Lord's return, that some will depart from the faith, to teach doctrines of devils.

The Holy Spirit describes these false prophets as having their conscience seared, because they are reprobates, and so they speak lies and hypocrisy.

Again, this isn't Paul's spiritual discernment leading to his writing a prophetic dark saying, he says this is directly spoken by the Spirit, by God. And these are the examples of what those devilish doctrines of lies will teach; Forbidding to marry and abstaining from meats, insinuating that they will deceive those giving heed to seducing spirits, with the appearance of holiness.

It shouldn't have to be said that this is directed at the same heresies the RCC would eventually take up. Their doctrines of devils.

This is one of many admonitions against specific practices that the Catholic Church and many of its harlot daughters teach. Warnings against Idolatry, building ornate temples, vain repetitive prayers, having other mediators with God the Father than the man Christ Jesus, calling men "Father," taking heed to Jewish fables, adding works and "sacraments" to the Gospel, disregarding God's word as the only source for doctrine, persecution of believers, and here, forbidding to marry and abstaining from meats.

As if that were not enough, there is Scripture recording Jesus saying to those seeking to worship Mary, "*Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it*." and "*Who is my mother, or my brethren?...Behold my mother and my brethren! For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother."*

The word of God, spoken before the foundation of the world, and published in these latter times, expressly addresses the false teachers and their doctrines of what Jesus' revelation to John calls "the whore of Babylon." More than 200 years before the Roman empire created the Catholic Church. And still today some take heed of its seducing spirits and are led astray.

teachings.title: Worshipping God in vain by the traditions of men
teachings.summary: Like the Pharisees, the Catholic Church and her daughters leave God's commandments for man-made rituals and seek grace doled out by men.
teachings.text:
The repudiation of following what is the tradition of men, worshiping God in vain, continues. Jesus Christ in condemning the hypocrisy of the Pharisees gives us insight to all who are like them, leaving the commandments of God to embrace the traditions of man, and lose their way. Such is the Catholic Church today. So to its daughters. Making their own commandments and rituals, which do nothing spiritually for them, which don't please God, and often bring His wrath. Leaving the Biblical doctrines God has given us to chase idols and false sacrament, rites and rituals of pagans. Seeking to be given grace by increments, doled out by men rather than God.

So to here, the Pharisees and scribes come to accuse the disciples for not engaging in ritual hand washing prior to eating which was their human tradition, not a command of God. Jesus calls them out on this hypocrisy.

Jesus points out that these vipers have condoned men dishonoring their parents, by declaring their own wealth to be "Corban" that is, belonging to God (despite their keeping it and using it for themselves), cutting off their parents from support which God commands us to provide. ([See Matthew 15 parallel study](https://t.me/HouseOfWews2/5226))

teachings.title: Rome denies the liberty that is in Christ
teachings.summary: The Roman Catholic Church and her daughters keep people yoked to works for justification, the error of Cain, denying the liberty of Christ.
teachings.text:
What the whore of Babylon, the Roman Catholic Church and its prot harlot daughters do is deny the liberty to the law that is in Christ Jesus, so that its adherents stay yoked to trying to justify themselves before God in their works.

But to we who are free in Christ by the free gift of salvation, we willingly become servants for righteousness, sanctifying ourselves, denying the flesh and walking in the spirit.

By denying the liberty, they damn those following their perverse false doctrine. And by relying on their vain works, they receive nothing but death and Hell, being debtors to the whole of the law.

*Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.*

God's word describes the man who seeks to be justified by dead works and adherence to the law as under bondage. Satan tells us that our feeble attempts at our own righteousness is sufficient. The error of Cain. But God says our righteousness are as filthy rags. Wood, hay and stubble.

And just as He rejected Cain's works and accepted Abel's offering of faith, so too it is for us today.

teachings.title: Judaizers and Rome Rebuild the Veil
teachings.summary: Hebrews refutes the Judaizers, and today Zionism, Hebrew roots and Rome likewise put priests and ordinances between man and God, though Christ is the only High Priest.
teachings.text:
God's message to the Hebrews, explaining the need for the end of the Mosaic law, the Levitical priesthood and the carnal ordinances comes to give these 1st century Hebrews confidence to reject the call to return to the vain traditions of man that many Jews were pushing early believers towards. The Judaizers who we see in Acts and the epistles persecuting and infiltrating the churches of the time seeking to return Christians to bondage under the law. Circumcision was a large part of it, but there were those claiming that they needed priests, sacrifice at the temple, to keep the days and feasts. The diverse washings. The vain traditions of man that became the Pharisaical laws.

But repeatedly, again and again, the Bible shows us this being reproved. That this was replaced in Christ and the liberty which was purchased by His blood upon the mercy seat in Heaven. Not a temple made by hands but that spiritual tabernacle in Heaven.

And even so, today, there are Judaizers among us, creeping in unawares. Bringing things like Zionism, "Hebrew roots," and other heresies to bring the believer back under the yoke of the law.

Further, we have established cults from the whore of Babylon in Rome and its harlot daughters, that seek to mend the veil and rebuild the earthly tabernacle, made by their own evil hands. To separate man from God again through their own preists, carnal ordinances, feasts and days. Bloodless redemption though human mediators. Grace doled out by weekly sacrifices. Dead works as a means of satisfying transgressions of the law which they yoke their followers with.

They *compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.*

They say "call us father," "Papa." Padre. Pope.
When Jesus said "*call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven."*

They place themselves between God and man to prevent the will of the Father, and the offer of the free gift of salvation, eternal life given by grace through faith.

But the letter to the Hebrews, from God through the Spirit, promises us that we have A, singular, High Priest after the order of Melchisedek, that in Christ Jesus we are forgiven our sins, adopted into the inheritance, and free to boldly go before the throne of God, directly to the Father, in the name of the Son. The Son Who isn't ashamed to call us brethren. Amen!

This is the better testament. This is the good news. Let no man prevent you. Now is the hour of salvation. Be born again unto eternal life. Repent from dead works to serve the living God.

teachings.title: Mary was saved by faith alone
teachings.summary: Luke records no immaculate conception; Mary was blessed and counted righteous by faith like every saint, so those who worship Mary miss God's grace.
teachings.text:
I would note that the gospel of Luke is the most thorough regarding the nativity of Jesus. It's what Linus quotes from in the Charlie Brown Christmas special. It's often what we think of and read from at Christmas time. And as Luke writes, this is a *declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us.*

And so we should notice what is absent. Those things which are not commonly believed among the first century Christians to whom this gospel is addressed.

There is no mention of the immaculate conception of Mary. There is no indication she was born without sin. While she exclaims in the Spirit that future generations shall call her blessed, it isn't because of a special quality of her's, but by the works of God to whom she's a servant. Mary does the will of God through faith, and in faith is blessed among women to be chosen to bear the incarnation of Christ Jesus. This is the grace that God bestows upon her for her faith. For her willingness to believe.

Just like the Old Testament saints, Mary believed and it was counted upon her for righteousness. She was saved by faith alone and chosen because of that faith.

The Bible says that without faith we cannot please God. Mary could not please God without faith. Zacharias and Elizabeth could not please God without faith. None of them could be righteous absent their belief that God has provided them remission of sins in his mercy. Given the gift of salvation from His grace.

Removing this concept from the gospel, those that worship Mary missed the entire point and so they cannot understand God's mercy and they cannot receive God's grace.

teachings.title: Making a physical idol of spiritual pictures
teachings.summary: False teachers take parables and pictures literally out of context and build doctrines of devils on them, such as infant sprinkling, sacramental bread and wine and praying to saints.
teachings.text:
This study is the meat of the word, it's hard for many to digest. The vain traditions of those who claim Christ but teach their own wisdom, rejecting the word of God as the only authority and twisting scripture to defend their doctrines of devils, has beguiled many.

And so we are warned;

*Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind.*

(BTW, that goes for praying to dead "saints," as angels)

People take doctrine from out of context verses, or partial text, and using the logic of man, puffed up in their fleshly mind, work out by fallacious implications that their heretical doctrines are actually Biblical.

They fail to square plainly stated and often repeated clear doctrines that directly contradict their own. They take literal readings of parables that they don't understand, and apply their carnal mind to the Spirit.

They are like Nicodemus, the Pharisee who questioned Jesus in **John 3**, unable to understand the parables about being born twice, once of water from the womb, again in Spirit, reborn by faith.

 They become like the disciples offended by His parable in **John 6**, where He compares Himself to manna, bread come down from Heaven that we must "eat." They thought this was some sort of cannibalistic blasphemy, despite Jesus explaining "*It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.*"

Even today, many take parables and metaphors, pictures of the spiritual and make for themselves a physical idol of it. Missing the point.

And so you have denominations claiming to believe that salvation is by faith alone, still maintaining that sprinkling of infants and ritualistic eating of bread and drinking of wine bestows salvation, or keeps it. That works must be done to shore up that which is by faith alone. The contradictions lost on them, as is salvation.

teachings.title: Penance is an affront to the gospel of grace
teachings.summary: Lenten penance contradicts salvation by grace and the finished work of Christ; fasting is to grow in God's will, not to pay for sins Jesus already paid.
teachings.text:
Another "Lenten" reminder that the concept of penance for sin is in direct contradiction with salvation by grace, and a slap in the face to the finished work of Jesus Christ, who died and suffered Hell for our sins that we may be forgiven.

Fasting is meant to help a saved Christian better understand the will of God that their faith grows, that they may accept it and do that will, to the benefit of others. To feed the spiritual new man by neglecting the old man of the flesh.

It is not to give "penance" for the sins Jesus already paid the price for, in a selfish effort to obtain forgiveness which is given to us freely by the grace of God.

The Bible says telling people to abstain from certain foods as a means of holiness is a doctrine of devils. The idea of penance doesn't exist in scripture. In fact, it is an affront to the Gospel of grace.

Reject these doctrines of devils and rely on the perfect work of Christ alone as the propitiation for your sin.

teachings.title: Penance is not in scripture
teachings.summary: The word penance is not in scripture, and the Catholic NAB inserts it into Isaiah 58:5, a passage where God calls such practices sin.
teachings.text:
BTW, the term "penance" doesn't appear anywhere in scripture, even in the more corrupt modern versions, but Catholics draw their proof text from **Isaiah 58:5**, a chapter as we just saw that explicitly has God calling such practices sin.

The New American Bible (NAB), a popular Catholic perversion of the word, twists the scripture and changes "afflict [your] soul" to "penance": “Is this the manner of fasting I wish, of keeping a day of penance: That a man bow his head like a reed, and lie in sackcloth and ashes? Do you call this a fast, a day acceptable to the LORD?”

They don't even see the folly of using this, in its actual context, to justify the idea, or promote the yoke of abstinence and fasting, ashes and self- that God is literally telling Isaiah to preach against.

They take from it only that they were being insincere, not that God calls us to delight in His day of rest, to celebrate the sabbath we have in Christ, and do for others that He be glorified. Only that the Hebrews just went about self flagellation wrong.

teachings.title: Thou hast the words of eternal life
teachings.summary: Peter understood that Christ's words, not literal flesh and blood, give eternal life, so those who teach literally eating Christ's body for salvation are not saved, and John 6 does not teach Calvinism.
teachings.text:
*Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away? Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life. And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.*

So we see that Peter understood the lesson. Peter was saved by faith, speaks the truth of what Jesus was conveying; that Jesus has the words of eternal life. Not the literal flesh and blood to consume to obtain it, but the words that by faith grant the believer eternal life, because Jesus is the Christ, the son of the living God.

This teaching is an excellent way to separate the believer from those who aren't. Jesus uses it to divide, to alienate and offend those who don't understand the spiritual application because they are there to have their bellies filled, or to see wonders, not because they seek salvation.

This still applies today. People who take any sort of literal view of actually eating the body and drinking the blood of Jesus to gain salvation are not saved and have not come to the knowledge of the truth. They are not called according to God's will, because they aren't seeking to know or understand it.

Don't get that twisted, though. This isn't an appeal to Calvinism. Again, **John 6** is a stumbling block for the unbelieving who use the "called" to teach their limited atonement damnable heresy.

*For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me. And this is the Father's will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day. And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.*

teachings.title: Good person, mass and purgatory cope
teachings.summary: Those trusting works claim to be good people yet call assurance presumption and invent purgatory, because they will not admit they are sinners deserving Hell.
teachings.text:
Talk with them, soul winning and even online, and they will say they know they are going to heaven because they are a "good person," or that they attend mass and take communion and go to confession. But in the back of their mind they know this isn't true, that they imperfectly follow the law of God, and even fall short of the traditions of man. And so they will hedge by saying it is presumption to claim to know if you're saved. That they "think so, but God decides at judgment." That unbiblical things like purgatory exist as a Plan B is a testament to the cope people will cling to to deny that they are sinners deserving death and Hell.

And the Gospel reminds them of this, triggers them, and their anger has resulted in persecution and murder of martyrs, just as the prophets slain in the OT times. Just as it did Christ. Just as it did the apostles and the early church and through the dark ages.

Man doesn't want to humble themselves to the truth of their nature and what they deserve. They seek reassurance that they are good. That they deserve salvation.

But we know this isn't true.

teachings.title: The Lord's supper versus Catholic communion
teachings.summary: Since God forbids eating blood and Jesus called the cup the fruit of the vine, the Lord's supper is a remembrance and the Catholic mass is a pagan perversion.
teachings.text:
In **Leviticus 17**, God reiterates His command that the children of Israel not consume blood. As we see from **Genesis 9** and **Acts 15**, this command predates the Levitical laws, and extends to the New Testament, where believers are told to not only abstain from consuming blood, but also food offered to idols.

The blood, the life thereof, *whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.*

We see in the ordinance of the Lord's supper, the remembrance of Christ's death and the new testament of His blood shed for the remission of sin.

**Matthew 26:26-29**
*And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body. And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink ye all of it; For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins. But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom.*

Now, knowing that the consumption of blood is an abomination to the Lord, cutting off someone from being a child of Israel, and that the law against it is not done away with the end of the Levitical ceremonial laws and ordinances, predating them, and being commanded by the apostles to the Gentiles, is there a contradiction?

Since God is not the author of confusion, and Jesus Himself says that this cup is still just grape juice after His blessing, *this fruit of the vine*, no.

It is a form of materialist literalism that has a false doctrine that the bread literally turns to flesh and the juice literally becomes blood when their priests offer up wine and crackers to idols. The Catholic hocus pocus is Nicodemus-level in missing the spiritual application and meaning, to turn Christianity into a cannibal cult.

In the Catholic religion, they call the offering of the bread and alcoholic wine, lifted up to graven images "a sacrifice." They pray to their idol that it be acceptable as a sacrifice. They consume meat offered to idols, and in their hearts, consume what they will claim is blood.

It is a wicked pagan perversion of what should be a simple remembrance:

**Luke 22:14-20**
*And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him. And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer: For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God. And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves: For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come. And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me. Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.*

What should be a sobering and holy remembrance is turned into an abomination and a mockery by the heathen practice of a Catholic communion.

teachings.title: Cakes to the queen of heaven
teachings.summary: Jeremiah 7 condemns sacraments over faith and specifically the worship of the queen of heaven, which Catholic Bibles annotate away.
teachings.text:
Let's not overlook the obvious; that God not only rebukes those who seek to be justified by their sacraments and ceremony, of vain works that betray their adulterous hearts, but also gives specific example of the Idolatry these supposed children of God have added to their worship.

*The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead their dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto other gods, that they may provoke me to anger. Do they provoke me to anger? saith the Lord: do they not provoke themselves to the confusion of their own faces?*

The preaching in chapter 7 destroys the idea of sacraments over faith, works over belief, and the serving of idols, specifically the worship of "the queen of heaven."

Of course the Catholic perversion of the Bible, the Douay–Rheims, has to include a note about this mention of the false god the people baked cakes to, holding feasts for. Because otherwise, someone might question this if they read it.

teachings.title: Who first trusted in Christ
teachings.summary: Ephesians 1 does not teach unconditional election, because the chosen are those who first trusted in Christ, and the elect nation is spiritual Israel, not the Jews of the flesh.
teachings.text:
Here we see in what is considered the strongest case for special boyism undone with one conditional phrase, "who first trusted in Christ."

Ephesians 1 and Romans 8 are the go to chapters used by special boys to justify their being "chosen" for salvation, but both Ephesians 1 and Romans 8 precede Ephesians 2 and Romans 9, the nails in the coffin of dispensationalism, the idea that only the Israel of the flesh were "chosen."

Paul is establishing that the new covenant is for Israel of the spirit, and has to establish that in the same way (saved and unsaved) physical Israel was predestined by God to be used for His purpose, so too saved Gentiles representing spiritual Israel are similarly a chosen nation.

That God in His foreknowledge destined and shaped those who would be heirs to the promise to be His tools on earth. That knowing who would believe and who wouldn't allows Him to craft the believers to be of best use for His will, is almost a secondary point of this scripture.

He's establishing that the Jews who are persecuting saved Gentiles, claiming that Israel of the flesh are still God's special boys and Gentiles aren't heirs to that kingdom or adopted sons of God, are liars.

teachings.title: The whole testimony is about free will
teachings.summary: From Eden to Revelation scripture shows men choosing, and God in His foreknowledge elects to blessings those who have first believed.
teachings.text:
God wouldn't go through so much trouble establishing His testimony, asking that people believe His word, that He cannot lie and illustrating the choice of man, from Adam and Eve in the garden, to Cain and Abel' faith vs works, Noah and the ark, Abraham and Isaac (and Ishmael/the bond woman), Esau and Jacob, the Northern/Southern Kingdoms, Jonah, Job, Jesus in the garden, Jews choosing Barabbas, Paul's epistles describing all these divergent points, Peter's peculiar people, Revelation of Christ showing the choice to accept the beast, take the mark, be sorted like sheep and goats, and even the devil being freed for a season to convince some humans who have just lived a thousand years of peace under Christ to rise up and rebel one final time.

The entire testimony, the living Testament of Christ, is about free will, informed choice. And we are called to share that testimony with others to give them that information, and lead them to the same conclusion.

And God, in His foreknowledge of who would choose to accept His word on faith, has a destiny for us, a plan for us, and promises and blessings that we are elected to receive having FIRST believed.

teachings.title: Sovereign does not mean puppet master
teachings.summary: Lordship salvation and Calvinism grow from modern bibles and a false idea of sovereignty, while God's word says whosoever believeth shall not perish.
teachings.text:
One thing that greatly confuses many searching for truth, and leads them into the damnable heresy of Lordship salvation and reformed Calvinism is they use modern perverted bibles, that insert words and concepts that aren't in the text, and that are then manipulated to deceive the ignorant.

Few would argue that God isn't LORD of creation, but the concept of "sovereign" shifts this truth to a false doctrine that reduces God to simply a puppet master micromanaging all of reality.

But even if we were to use the dictionary definition of the word 'sovereign,' it doesn't carry that implication. A sovereign may pass orders and laws and render judgement and punish the disobedient, but he can't force anyone to obey all his dictates.

I would that any deceived by this doctrine to repent and believe the testimony of God, that the only way to salvation is to trust His word, that He so loved the world He gave His only begotten son that WHOSOEVER believe shall not perish but have everlasting life

teachings.title: Romans 8: adopted after first believing
teachings.summary: Paul builds the case for conditional election: we are adopted as sons and joint heirs only after believing, and foreknowledge comes before predestination, which Calvinists reverse.
teachings.text:
Paul has for the past 7 chapters laid out the factual, Biblical case for *conditional election,* that **we must believe to be saved,** starting with the testimonial of God in creation, the lack of excuse by the unbelieving, the refusal to accept the knowledge of God of the reprobate, and the surety of our salvation of placing our faith in God's promise.

Here, tying together these themes, he speaks of the carnal mind that the saved still have, exhorting the saved by faith to live in the spirit, not the flesh, because in that righteousness given us is adoption into the promise; we become heirs of Christ, we call out to our Father. In verse 9, he makes it clear that this is a **conditional** state of being. You aren't adopted without first believing.

Then, Paul begins building onto this foundational theme of being adopted as sons in the spirit by explaining how God's foreknowledge that we (the saved) then be used to His purpose. (Note the order of operations in verse 29, calvanists reverse it, and thus get none of it).

The glory of being joint heirs with Christ, in Christ. The hope, which is an earnest expectation for the thing we believe to come (not a long-shot wish as some use the term) being shared with all of creation, waiting for that kingdom to come. That we are blameless to charge by any because we are justified in our faith in Christ. That, in faith, none can stand before us as God gives us all things, according to His will.

Having laid out the first faith and its terms and rewards, Paul is making the case to the saved to understand what their faith has opened them up to, what God's gifts mean to us if we now walk in the spirit, quickened by the Holy Ghost, that all things are for good to us for loving God, if we simply trust further in the word of God, building faith upon faith.

teachings.title: John 1: as many as received him
teachings.summary: John 1 shows Christ lights every man, that the world did not know Him, and that whoever receives Him by believing becomes a son of God, refuting limited atonement and irresistible grace.
teachings.text:
Next, the apostle John introduces us to John the Baptist, the voice crying out in the wilderness bearing witness to Christ.

John the apostle again turns to explain Jesus is the true light which "lighteth *every* man." (RIP limited atonement).

V10 states the matter plainly, the creator has come into the creation and the creation didn't even recognize Him, fallen as we are. Man doesn't recognize Christ (rip irresistible grace)

V11 lays the groundwork for replacement theology. The "chosen people" the Jews don't recognize Christ

V11 is the Gospel itself; the good news. "As many received him..." (that's an indeterminate number, meaning 'all who' (limited atonement BTFO, again), "...to them gave he power to become the sons of God" (the promise made by God), "even to them that believe on his name" (the means of obtaining the aforementioned power to be sons of God; BELIEVING, not works or any other means).

V13 Sons born (you have to be born again to be a son or daughter of God). Not by blood (dispensationalism, ded), not by our fleshly desire (none righteous), not by our works (the will of man) but of God.

V14 is the mystery of Christ made flesh revealed.
V15-17 John the BAPTIST (hint) tells us his ministry has been preaching the coming Christ and salvation by grace, not the law.

When JtB is questioned by the Pharisees he testifies that Jesus is the Christ come in answer to what was taught by all the prophets, the faith that saved OT saints was manifest.

About halfway through one chapter and the doctrines are just boom, boom, boom...

teachings.title: Predestinated in Christ, not chosen individuals
teachings.summary: In Ephesians 1 it is Christ who was predestinated and we are chosen and accepted only in Him, obtaining the inheritance after we hear and trust the gospel and are sealed, so Calvinism misplaces the focus.
teachings.text:
What an introduction. Paul lays so much doctrine in what is only the greeting of his letter to believers at Ephesus. It's fantastic, and dense and due to the extensive use of prepositional clauses, causes many believers and all natural men to struggle in understanding.

One aspect of understanding the Word is understanding God's use of conditional logic, if-then statements, often complex with multiple factors. This method of reasoning together with God is evident in this epistle.

Paul is an Apostle, *by* the will of God. He's writing to the saints, the faithful *in* Jesus Christ. He wishes grace and peace to the reader *from* God and Jesus. God has blessed us *with* all spiritual blessings.

Keeping this in mind, consider verse 4-6:

According as he hath chosen us *in him* (Jesus) before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children **by** Jesus Christ **t**o himself, *according to the good pleasure of his will, To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he* (God) *hath made us accepted* in the beloved *(*Jesus*).*

The error of Calvinism is to misapply the focus of predestination to those benefiting from it, rather than *by* whom, Jesus Christ.

God has chosen us *in Jesus*. Predestinated *by Christ.* Accepted *in the beloved,* His Son.

Jesus is the Son of God, beloved of the Father, the lamb slain before the foundation of the world. Jesus was predestinated to be the means *by which* we received grace.

We weren't chosen. He was. We are only adopted sons, because of Jesus *In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace.*

Paul is lauding God the Father and the Son, Christ Jesus, he is not indicating that the believers are special boys, predestined, but that in Christ through God's grace, we are.

*In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will.*

We obtain the inheritance in Jesus who was predestinated according to the will of God.

And this isn't a question of perspective and interpretation, because Paul then makes our role in this process abundantly clear:

That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.

*In whom ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise, Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.*

Follow that? We gain this inheritance IN Christ who we trusted when we heard the Gospel, and after hearing and believing, being sealed by the Holy Spirit. These are the conditional terms of our obtaining the inheritance, our salvation. Not God picking and choosing us, but God having predestinated Christ, that those *who first trusted* in Him are included in the inheritance.

It's an order of operations that is focused on God and His Son. Our part is in believing it to be true.

teachings.title: Jacob have I loved, Esau have I hated
teachings.summary: The hatred of Esau refers to the later wicked nation of Edom, not to Esau himself, who God blessed and who was saved by faith, against the Calvinist reading.
teachings.text:
He is Esau who is Edom. He is Esau the father of the Edomites.

We are given the genealogies of Esau, who is Edom, which God repeats for us several times, to drive home the point.

The primary target for this scripture were the Israelites in Moses day, sharing their people's story and the story of the people of Mt Seir, who they are coming up against as we will see later in scripture. Cousins really. One with the blessing and the promise for the seed that is Christ to come.

Esau himself is often painted in a negative light, primarily due to a Calvinist reading of **Romans 9:13**:

*As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.*

Which is itself taken from the prophet **Malachi 1:3-4**

*And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness. Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places; thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever. And your eyes shall see, and ye shall say, The Lord will be magnified from the border of Israel.*

Note, these are the Edomites generations later, being cursed by God. Not Esau, who is Edom.

And why were they cursed by God for destruction? In **Deuteronomy 2:1-5**, God orders the Israelites to tread carefully through the land of Seir so as not to worry the Edomites. That their land was promised Esau:

*Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea, as the Lord spake unto me: and we compassed mount Seir many days.*

*And the Lord spake unto me, saying,*
*Ye have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.*
*And command thou the people, saying, Ye are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore: Meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a foot breadth; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession.*

We see at this point God is still allowing the nations of Edom, who is Esau to continue with His blessing of a promised land to their patriarch.

God loved Esau, despite his failings. He made a promise to him and kept it, even in those days, 400yrs later.

Esau was saved by the same faith as Jacob, and their fathers. But his descendents became wicked.

**Numbers 20:14-21**

*And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom, Thus saith thy brother Israel, Thou knowest all the travail that hath befallen us:*
*How our fathers went down into Egypt, and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians vexed us, and our fathers: And when we cried unto the Lord, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and hath brought us forth out of Egypt: and, behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of thy border:*

*Let us pass, I pray thee, through thy country: we will not pass through the fields, or through the vineyards, neither will we drink of the water of the wells: we will go by the king's high way, we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed thy borders.*

*And Edom said unto him, Thou shalt not pass by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword. And the children of Israel said unto him, We will go by the high way: and if I and my cattle drink of thy water, then I will pay for it: I will only, without doing anything else, go through on my feet.*

*And he said, Thou shalt not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand. Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: wherefore Israel turned away from him.*

Later we see Edomites war with Israel, and eventually David conquers and takes them as servants, slaves.

**2 Samuel 8:13-14**

teachings.title: Predestinated in Christ, not chosen to believe
teachings.summary: Predestination in Ephesians 1 and Romans 8 is in Christ, not God choosing who will believe, since God will have all men to be saved and draws all men, so Calvinism and limited atonement are doctrines of devils rooted in pride.
teachings.text:
**Ephesians 1:3-6**
*Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will, To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved*.

So what is this that is predestined? The saved? Or Christ Jesus by whom we are saved?

Calvinists read this and **Romans 8**, and place the emphasis on themselves, rather than Christ, and so, they claim, that God picks who will believe. This doctrine of devils, like all false gospels, is based on putting themselves before the Lord. Just as works salvation is predicated on the person's own righteousness, not Christ's, the special boy doctrine makes it that they are the elect, not of Jesus perfect work, the lamb slain before the foundation of the world, that all who believe on Him will be saved, but by God's "sovereign will."

But we know that God's will is not for a chosen few.

**1 Timothy 2:3-4**
*For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour; Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.*

If God exerted His sovereign will, we would all be saved.

As Jesus says,

*And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.*

Every one.

Limited atonement is a doctrine of devils. It is based on pride.

So we know that all who believe are predestinated in Christ that they will have eternal life, sealed by the Spirit, and if they walk in tha Spirit, will be conformed to the use of God, that we may become separated, to be servants of the Gospel.

And so continuing the theme of Romans 8, the context of which is the works of the Spirit.

That while we are yet in the flesh, knowing the day of redemption will free us from that wretched state, that the Spirit helps heal our infirmities that led us to sin and conforms us to His will, so long as we walk after the Spirit, not feeding the flesh with the things of this world. That the Spirit within us acts also as an intercessor to bring our needs before the Father, so that His will be done in us.

And so, the good news;

*And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.*

Who is called? Who is drawn to faith in God's promise?

**John 12:32-33**
*And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me. This he said, signifying what death he should die.*

All men. But few will answer this call, and seek to be transformed to fulfill His intended purpose for us. The harvest is great but the laborers few. Strait is the gate and narrow the way and few there be that find it. Every name of every person born of water upon this earth is in the book of life. But their names are stricken from it when they die in sin, unbelieving. (Or reprobates, twice-dead)

No where in the Bible do we see names added, only erased. God's foreknowledge, knowing of the end from the beginning, means He knows who will answer the call. It doesn't mean He selects them.

teachings.title: Hath not the potter power over the clay
teachings.summary: God's predestination is the election of believers in Christ, not choosing who believes, and He may use vessels of wrath for His glory.
teachings.text:
Is God then unrighteous? Is it unfair that some are saved and others burned, that those who are elected in faith through Christ are shaped to His purpose, while those who reject the faith and deny the truth have their hearts eventually hardened, cut off and burned?

*Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will? Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus? Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?*

Who are we to judge God?

*But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth*...

It is His will to be done. That Jesua would be born of a woman, live, be crucified and raised again, to be made Lord as His son, and that all who believe be given eternal life, sealed by the Spirit and given hope to the resurrection, heirs to the Kingdom. Made sons of God.

This is the predestination of God. Not picking and choosing who believes, but the elected in Christ, using those who do to His purpose.

And if His purpose is to show His glory and righteousness through those vessels of wrath, then so be it.

*We are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things.*

teachings.title: Traditions not even in the Bible
teachings.summary: The Galatians at least followed something God once ordained, but the mystery religion of Babylon and her harlot daughters trusts in extra-biblical traditions of men.
teachings.text:
And not to damn the Galatians with faint praise, but at least they were being beguiled into obeying something that actually was ordained by God in the Old Testament, if done away with in Christ.

How many people calling themselves Christian are putting their faith in something that isn't even in the Bible? That has no actual examples in scripture? That are twisted from incoherent cherry picking?

You can *almost* see the errors of those trusting baptism to save them, a natural man reading of scripture could lead them to that I suppose.

Unsaved people might be persuaded to think that the Lord's supper is some kind of magic ritual bringing them an installment of grace. (I'm speaking kindly of those holding on to damnable heresy, that it might jostle some in to repentance. But that benefit of the doubt doesn't mean they aren't damned).

But the entirety of the Mystery Religion of Babylon, practiced by the whore and her harlot daughters, is extra-biblical, vain traditions of men. Repent and trust in Christ alone. Believe God's word alone.

teachings.title: Christ the bridegroom and the whore of Babylon
teachings.summary: Scripture pictures God's people as a bride and idolatry as adultery and whoredom, which is why the Roman Catholic Church is shown as the whore of Babylon, mother of harlots.
teachings.text:
Throughout scripture, God's relationship to His people is likened unto a marriage, Christ Jesus as the bridegroom, believers the bride. And just as married couples are joined together, become of one flesh, and adultery an abomination, so too scripture refers to chasing after false gods and idols as adultery.

The fornication with which a man may put away his betrothed is a like symbol of God's putting away a people who have gone after strange gods. He also calls it whoredom.

Scripture says to suffer not a harlot of the daughters of Israel, and it is both literal and symbolic of the call by God to be faithful unto Him.

That is why the Roman Catholic Church, the Whore of Babylon, mother of harlots, is represented this way. The cup of her fornication. It's all relative in terms to the bride, the believers in Christ who remain faithful.

The institution of marriage itself is a parable by which God teaches us of fidelity, and what it means to be a jealous God. How the man is head of the house, one body and one flesh with his wife, just as Jesus is head of His body, made up of the saints.

The one world religion of works and many gods will be used by the beast to gain control, until they turn on the whore and install the antichrist in the temple, proclaiming himself as God, Christ returned.

teachings.title: Miry Clay Mingled with Iron
teachings.summary: The miry clay mixed with iron may be false believers, chiefly the Catholic Church and her harlot daughters seeking political power.
teachings.text:
Delving a little bit deeper, we see Daniel talking about the feet of clay mixed with iron in the statue described in the dream. Traditionally in scripture the clay often represents believers. But here it is called mirey clay, contaminated so as to not bind, mixed with iron which is the power of the state,, the remnant of the Roman Empire's power.

This may represent false believers. Those who profess to be Christian but are not and have another gospel, primarily the Catholic Church.

Revelation, as we will see in chapter 17, will describe the whore of Babylon and her harlot daughters. From the description it clearly is the Roman Catholic Church, her harlot daughters the Protestants and various evangelical sects that have splintered off from the whore over the millennia. These churches claiming to be of Christ but seeking political power in the world.

 Mirey clay mingled with iron.

And these 10 kingdoms of the final empire will be who gives the antichrist his power to rule.

teachings.title: Mystery Babylon, the mother of harlots
teachings.summary: The great whore on seven hills is Rome and its apostate church, with the false religions sprung from her as harlot daughters, drunk with the blood of the saints she martyred in a trail of blood, until the beast and his kingdom make war with the Lamb and are overcome.
teachings.text:
The Whore, Mystery Babylon the Great. Mother of harlots and abominations. Drunken with the blood of the saints she martyred. The golden cup filled of her filthy fornication and abominations.

*That great city which reigneth over the kings of the earth*.

Sitting upon 7 mountains.
Given power by kings to rule.
Decked in purple and scarlet, gold and precious stones and pearls.

Sitting upon many waters, which are peoples and multitudes and nations and tongues.

Who is this great whore? This mother of harlots? This city on 7 mountains, that sits on many waters? Who has martyred the saints of Jesus and committed fornication and blasphemy and other abominations against God?

The city on seven hills is Rome. Its whore, the false religion and apostate church of the Roman Catholics. The harlot daughters all the other false religions that have sprung from it. The Orthodox and the Protestant. All those calling themselves Christ's, professing themselves to be holy and true. But drunk in her fornications. Idolatry. Blasphemy. The abominations of her golden cup. The power of her political control, given by the kings that committed adultery with her. The murder of millions of believers, in a trail of blood, as this empire of mirey clay and iron has conquered much of the earth.

In the end, the 7th empire as described by Daniel (we will look at Daniel 7 tomorrow, along with the destruction of Babylon), will give the beast power to reign and will promote the worship of the beast who was, is not and is again. The fatal wound and Satan bringing the antichrist back to life as the man of perdition, and installing him as the head of the final one world government and religion for a short space.

*These shall make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them: for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings: and they that are with him are called, and chosen, and faithful.*

teachings.title: The Spirit of Babylon Is Whoredom
teachings.summary: Babel was the first works-based one world religion, and its spirit of idolatry is spiritual whoredom, which gives the context for the whore of Babylon.
teachings.text:
The study today on Revelation 17 and the Whore of Babylon, as well as tomorrow and the fall of that wicked city, has a lot of context coming from scripture, and concepts regarding the faithfulness of God, the betrothal to His people and the eventual marriage of the Lamb.

God has given us His law regarding marriage as a picture of His relationship with the saved. He is a jealous God. He speaks against Idolatry and having other gods, the blasphemy of worshiping graven and molten images or other creatures in His stead as fornication, whoredoms. Harlotry. He draws parallel to actual whores, allowing the daughters of your land to commit fornication and it destroying a nation, with the destruction visited on those who forsake Him to chase after strange gods.

There are many chapters and verses, but those I provided should give you some ideas of this major theme throughout the Bible.

The spirit of Babel, which is Babylon, and the empires and kingdoms that followed it, is one of adultery. Fornication. Whoredoms.

The original sin of the first one-world religion and government, just years after the flood, was to blaspheme God by building a tower to Heaven. Working their way to righteousness, that they may become as gods.

The Tower of Babel being a symbol of all works-based false religion. It's destruction, a picture of the end times.

Just as Babylon the empire, and Nebuchadnezzar and his idol, are a picture of the beast and his abomination. Harlots, taking from God what is His. Leading man to fornication.

This spirit of Babylon and its whore of self-righteous works religion, bowing to idols, worshiping the created more than the creator, is fornication.

God's law says that a betrothed groom can only put away his intended bride for fornication. And that no man may then marry her that has been put away.

This is the context, fufifiled in the end times prophecy.

teachings.title: The Whore and the Bride
teachings.summary: The whore and the Lamb's bride are set in contrast: trusting idols, rites or works is spiritual adultery against a jealous God.
teachings.text:
There is an interesting contrast made in the opening verse of chapter 17, and a verse from chapter 21:

**Revelation 17:1**
*And there came one of the seven angels which had the seven vials, and talked with me, saying unto me, Come hither; I will shew unto thee the judgment of the great whore that sitteth upon many waters:*

Revelation 21:9
*And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues, and talked with me, saying, Come hither, I will shew thee the bride, the Lamb's wife.*

The whore represents the unsaved and the wicked. The saved as the Lamb's wife, a bride.

The contrast and context of faithfulness and purity is intentional. A parable for a God whose name is Jealous.

*For thou shalt worship no other god: for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.*

As Jesus teaches in Matthew 5:28

*But I say unto you, That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.*

The same is true for us spiritually. When we put other gods before Him, even in our hearts, or trust in something other than Him to be our Lord and savior, it is adultery.

To make your faith one of idols and rites and vain traditions, trusting in our works and institutions made of man over the Lord who bought you, it is whoremongering. It is fornication.

And all those who lead others to this, especially when they claim the name of Christ Jesus, are harlots. Whores. And they serve the beast.

teachings.title: The Fall of Babylon the Great City
teachings.summary: Babylon is destroyed last in the wrath, and the seat of Babylon is always some nation embodying its spirit, which today looks like the United States.
teachings.text:
And so, as the vials and trumps come to an end, the three and a half years of wrath poured out, special judgment is given against that great city, Babylon.

This is prophetic in the OT of both the actual Babylonian empire, but also the future empire represented in night visions and dreams interpreted by Daniel, and preached by the other prophets, which as we see in scripture, all speak of God's wrath followed by the coming of Christ and His kingdom.

When Jesus said that to Him gave all the prophets witness, we can see just how true that is.

And as we near the end of the judgement of the earth, and draw near to Christ's reign, the beast is readying the armies of man to resist Jesus and His saints. The earth has seen plagues and destruction since the day of the Lord. The sun and moon darkening and the rapture of the saints. Man has been in constant torment and fear from locusts from Hell, waters turned bitter and turned to blood. Fire from the sky and earthquakes. Giant hail. A relentless pouring out of God's wrath.

And at the end of all this, the representation of Babylon, the nation at the heart of the one world empire, is utterly destroyed in the span of an hour. Saved for last, God allows the people of the earth to see His righteous judgement upon it for the blood of the martyrs and the drunkenness of its fornication and abominations.

It is difficult not to see the United States as this city, especially given the merchants lament at the destruction of a great consumer nation. I believe that there is always a seat of Babylon, a country that embodies its spirit. Rome. London. The United States.

It is possible that should God be even more longsuffering than we reckon, it could be Hong Kong or some other nation that becomes the center for the beast. Every man feels like *surely these must be the final days.* I can't even imagine how they felt in WW2 for example. And yet even more horrors and evil were to come.

But reading this chapter, and the way it is described, it's difficult not to see things falling into place, faster and faster now. The beginning of sorrows feels imminent. And we long for the day when the angels sing out "*Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her."*

teachings.title: Worse than thy sister Sodom
teachings.summary: God was more offended by Judah's spiritual whoredom than by Sodom, so His greatest wrath is for apostate churches like Rome and the Orthodox, more than for sodomites.
teachings.text:
In **Ezekiel 16**, as the Lord speaks through the prophet to condemn Judah and put away the children of Israel as His beloved for her fornication, with the promise of her destruction and the new covenant of Christ, we see their sin compared to that of Sodom's, and it is worse for her whoredoms.

Going after strange Gods, murdering their children and offering sacrifice and incense to idols made of men.

If you recall our recent series on Exodus, you may recognize how God describes His decking of the figurative Israel in skins and linens, gold and precious stones, the same as the Tabernacle He had Moses build.

This is a bill of divorcement, and should give the Zionist dispensationalist crowd to repent, but I want to focus on the sin of Sodom compared to the sins laid at the feet of the children of Judah.

*And thine elder sister is Samaria, she and her daughters that dwell at thy left hand: and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand, is Sodom and her daughters. Yet hast thou not walked after their ways, nor done after their abominations: but, as if that were a very little thing, thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways. As I live, saith the Lord God, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters. Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy. And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw good.*

God, having laid out their sin, and that in their pride they say they aren't as wicked as the Canaanites, or as Sodom, He reminds them they are of the land of Canaan; their father Abraham was an Amorite, and mother Sarah an Hittite. And so they are sisters of Sodom.

And for all the abominations and pride of Sodom, who God rightly saw fit to destroy and kill all those wicked people, God is more offended by His chosen people, His intended bride, and her not only fornicating after strange gods, not only passing the children He blessed them with through the fire, not only taking their riches and the sacrifices that are His and giving them to idols, going after outlandish gods and people, but doing it for free. Out of insatiable self-indulgence. Not as for hire like most harlots, but just to do it.

It is incredibly important that we Christians, and those who call themselves Christian, recognize during this month of "pride" and filthy reprobates being rebuked for their unnatural lusts, to remember that while God hates f@gs, and has them fit for destruction, His real wrath is kindled in our own apostasy, our own whoredoms. Our own fornication.

God hates the great whore, the Roman Catholic Church, the Orthodox Church, and other harlot daughters, *more* than Sodom.

Unfaithfulness of those claiming to be His intended is more wicked than the filth of Sodom. And the wrath against them will be as it were against Israel, against Judah. Against Sodom and Gomorrah, and worse.

teachings.title: O wretched man that I am
teachings.summary: False prophets use Romans 7 to teach repent-of-your-sins works salvation or sinless living, but they deceive themselves and produce only fruit-inspecting hypocrites.
teachings.text:
*O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?*

Some false prophets use Romans 7 to teach a works-based, repent of your sins salvation. They use similar verses to teach that if you have sin you aren't saved. They will even claim they themselves are without sin.

**1 John 1:8**
*If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.*

**Revelation 22**
*But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone: which is the second death.*

These people are vipers. They have a false gospel. They produce no fruit, just bitter people unable to ever come to perfection, and trusting in their own works to save them.

Or worse, they make hypocrites, "fruit inspectors," who spend their time being holier than thou and touting their own righteousness, and glorying in their separation, but who never do the actual works of the spirit. Who can't win someone to Christ. At best, if they believed at one point, they create nothing but wood, hay and stubble.

But most aren't believers and just bring filthy rags before the judgment seat of Christ, saying *Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?*

And He will say to them, depart from me I never knew you.

teachings.title: Lordship salvation is a false gospel
teachings.summary: Requiring people to make Jesus Lord of their life or repent of their sins to be saved makes man his own savior and is another gospel.
teachings.text:
Lordship salvation is a false doctrine, put forth by vipers that say you have to "make Jesus the Lord of your life," or "boss of your life," in order to be saved. That you have to "repent of your sins" and try to "avoid sin," or you cannot be saved.

This is wicked as Hell.

To be saved we must understand that we are sinners and incapable of justifying ourselves to God. This is only part of accepting salvation, and part of Biblical repentance that is taught in nearly all independent fundamentalist Baptist churches. It is a part of the truth we must believe to actually trust on Christ for our salvation.

But the idea that our salvation rests in any way with our ability to turn from sin makes the person their own savior, robs the glory of God, and puts Christ to an open shame.

People who are giving a false gospel that includes "turning from your sin" or making Jesus the "boss of your life," are false teachers and are bringing another gospel.

Jesus is Lord, and God sits on His throne whether you believe or not. Whether you backslide or whether you go soul winning and Bible reading daily and attending church 3 times a week.

The humility and humbling of ourselves comes from the recognition that we are sinners, deserving death and Hell. Our salvation is in accepting that Jesus died for us, and we are washed clean in the blood. Not in how well we strive to live a perfect sinless life.

teachings.title: By their fruits: works-based false prophets
teachings.summary: By their fruits ye shall know them is about false prophets, whose works-based gospel produces insecure, legalistic, hypocritical followers.
teachings.text:
Ultimately, works-based false religion is about pride, and those who push this evil rely on that pride as a way to snare the unsuspecting into their false religion, and away from the truth of God.

It allows them to teach as commandments traditions of men. It allows them to dictate others' "salvation," by letting them set the standard one must reach. It is the root of every false religion.

And you can judge them by their fruit.

**Matthew 7:15-20**
*Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.*
*Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles? Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit. A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit. Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire. Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.*

This is the context of "by their fruits ye shall know them." It isn't about judging someone's salvation, but judging a false prophet. The fruit are those acolytes they gather to themselves.

Works-based "repent of your sins" false prophets create proselytes unsure of their salvation, constantly looking for measures and signs that they are, rather than faith in trusting God's word. And because we all fall short of the glory of God, they begin to be legalistic and holier than thou, seeking to make another man's behavior the mark they have to be better than, that they may look down upon them. It creates hypocrisy and respect of persons. They produce thorns and thistles. Not fruit meet for repentance.

teachings.title: No one is saved by repent of your sins
teachings.summary: A gospel of repenting of sins and making Jesus your boss saves no one, since we are saved only by believing on the Son.
teachings.text:
I just listened to a 4-minute audio clip titled "How do you actually get saved according to the Word of God?" that never once quoted scripture, used unbiblical terms like "repent of your sins," "admit you're desperately wicked," "make Jesus your boss," "make Jesus your Lord," that finished with strawman and ad hominem in defense of this damnable heresy.

No one can get saved by someone telling them this.

They are saved by this truth; *He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.*

It is not how bad we feel about being a sinner. It isn't how well we do walking in the Spirit. It isn't how willing we are to enter into discipleship.

It is believing in your heart that Jesus Christ is the Son of God, as the eunuch professed, period.

He did it all.

teachings.title: What must I do to be saved
teachings.summary: Answering a seeker with repent of your sins instead of believe on the Lord Jesus Christ only leads to confusion, discouragement and perdition.
teachings.text:
And imagine being an unsaved but seeking person, desperate to know what they must do to be saved, like the Philipian jailer, and you ask "Sirs, what must I do to be saved?"

And the answer isn't "Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ," but instead is "well, you have to repent of your sins."

"What does that mean? Like stop sinning? What if I can't? Which sins? The really bad ones? What if I don't realize it's a sin? What if I slip up?"

"Well, try to avoid sin. You have to want to avoid sin."

"How? I can't be saved if I don't try to avoid sin? I already am trying not to drink/smoke/watch porn. Is that good enough? How will I know if it's good enough? If I'm good enough?"

"Well then make Jesus your boss. Make him the Lord of your life."

"Isn't He already? What does that even mean? Do I have to sell everything and follow Him like the young rich man?"

Etc...

It is not a Gospel presentation. It's an invitation to confusion, discouragement and perdition.
